audit_status.source_base: Greek Gospel text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for census, birth in Bethlehem, manger, shepherd announcement, angelic peace, circumcision/name, temple presentation, Simeon, Anna, Nazareth return, and twelve-year-old Jesus.

verses.restored: In those days a decree went out from Caesar Augustus that all the inhabited world should be registered.

familiar.text: And it came to pass in those days, that there went out a decree from Caesar Augustus, that all the world should be taxed.

modern.text: Now in those days a decree went out from Caesar Augustus that a census should be taken of the whole empire.

original.text: Ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις ἐξῆλθεν δόγμα παρὰ Καίσαρος Αὐγούστου ἀπογράφεσθαι πᾶσαν τὴν οἰκουμένην·

verses.restored: This first registration happened while Quirinius was governing Syria.

familiar.text: (And this taxing was first made when Cyrenius was governor of Syria.)

modern.text: This was the first census to take place while Quirinius was governor of Syria.

original.text: (⸀αὕτη ἀπογραφὴ πρώτη ἐγένετο ἡγεμονεύοντος τῆς Συρίας Κυρηνίου·)

verses.restored: All went to be registered, each to his own city.

familiar.text: And all went to be taxed, every one into his own city.

modern.text: And everyone went to his own town to register.

original.text: καὶ ἐπορεύοντο πάντες ἀπογράφεσθαι, ἕκαστος εἰς τὴν ⸀ἑαυτοῦ πόλιν.

verses.restored: Joseph also went up from Galilee, from the city Nazareth, to Judea, to David's city, which is called Bethlehem, because he was from the house and family line of David,

familiar.text: And Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judaea, unto the city of David, which is called Bethlehem; (because he was of the house and lineage of David:)

modern.text: So Joseph also went up from Nazareth in Galilee to Judea, to the city of David called Bethlehem, since he was from the house and line of David.

original.text: Ἀνέβη δὲ καὶ Ἰωσὴφ ἀπὸ τῆς Γαλιλαίας ἐκ πόλεως Ναζαρὲθ εἰς τὴν Ἰουδαίαν εἰς πόλιν Δαυὶδ ἥτις καλεῖται Βηθλέεμ, διὰ τὸ εἶναι αὐτὸν ἐξ οἴκου καὶ πατριᾶς Δαυίδ,

verses.restored: to be registered with Mary, who had been betrothed to him, being pregnant.

familiar.text: To be taxed with Mary his espoused wife, being great with child.

modern.text: He went there to register with Mary, who was pledged to him in marriage and was expecting a child.

original.text: ἀπογράψασθαι σὺν Μαριὰμ τῇ ⸂ἐμνηστευμένῃ αὐτῷ⸃, οὔσῃ ἐγκύῳ.

verses.restored: While they were there, the days were fulfilled for her to give birth.

familiar.text: And so it was, that, while they were there, the days were accomplished that she should be delivered.

modern.text: While they were there, the time came for her Child to be born.

original.text: ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν τῷ εἶναι αὐτοὺς ἐκεῖ ἐπλήσθησαν αἱ ἡμέραι τοῦ τεκεῖν αὐτήν,

verses.restored: She gave birth to her firstborn son, wrapped him in cloths, and laid him in a manger, because there was no place for them in the guest room.

familiar.text: And she brought forth her firstborn son, and wrapped him in swaddling clothes, and laid him in a manger; because there was no room for them in the inn.

modern.text: And she gave birth to her firstborn, a Son. She wrapped Him in swaddling cloths and laid Him in a manger, because there was no room for them in the inn. The Shepherds and the Angels

original.text: καὶ ἔτεκεν τὸν υἱὸν αὐτῆς τὸν πρωτότοκον, καὶ ἐσπαργάνωσεν αὐτὸν καὶ ἀνέκλινεν αὐτὸν ⸀ἐν φάτνῃ, διότι οὐκ ἦν αὐτοῖς τόπος ἐν τῷ καταλύματι.

verses.restored: In the same region there were shepherds living in the fields, keeping watch over their flock by night.

familiar.text: And there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the field, keeping watch over their flock by night.

modern.text: And there were shepherds residing in the fields nearby, keeping watch over their flocks by night.

original.text: Καὶ ποιμένες ἦσαν ἐν τῇ χώρᾳ τῇ αὐτῇ ἀγραυλοῦντες καὶ φυλάσσοντες φυλακὰς τῆς νυκτὸς ἐπὶ τὴν ποίμνην αὐτῶν.

verses.restored: A messenger of the Lord stood over them, and glory of the Lord shone around them, and they feared a great fear.

familiar.text: And, lo, the angel of the Lord came upon them, and the glory of the Lord shone round about them: and they were sore afraid.

modern.text: Just then an angel of the Lord stood before them, and the glory of the Lord shone around them, and they were terrified.

original.text: ⸀καὶ ἄγγελος κυρίου ἐπέστη αὐτοῖς καὶ δόξα κυρίου περιέλαμψεν αὐτούς, καὶ ἐφοβήθησαν φόβον μέγαν·

verses.restored: The messenger said to them, Do not fear, for look, I announce to you good news of great joy that will be for all the people.

familiar.text: And the angel said unto them, Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people.

modern.text: But the angel said to them, “Do not be afraid! For behold, I bring you good news of great joy that will be for all the people:

original.text: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὁ ἄγγελος· Μὴ φοβεῖσθε, ἰδοὺ γὰρ εὐαγγελίζομαι ὑμῖν χαρὰν μεγάλην ἥτις ἔσται παντὶ τῷ λαῷ,

verses.restored: Today in David's city a Savior was born for you, who is Messiah, Lord.

familiar.text: For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.

modern.text: Today in the city of David a Savior has been born to you. He is Christ the Lord!

original.text: ὅτι ἐτέχθη ὑμῖν σήμερον σωτὴρ ὅς ἐστιν χριστὸς κύριος ἐν πόλει Δαυίδ·

verses.restored: This will be the sign for you: you will find a baby wrapped in cloths and lying in a manger.

familiar.text: And this shall be a sign unto you; Ye shall find the babe wrapped in swaddling clothes, lying in a manger.

modern.text: And this will be a sign to you: You will find a baby wrapped in swaddling cloths and lying in a manger.”

original.text: καὶ τοῦτο ὑμῖν ⸀τὸ σημεῖον, εὑρήσετε βρέφος ἐσπαργανωμένον ⸀καὶ κείμενον ἐν φάτνῃ.

verses.restored: Suddenly there was with the messenger a multitude of the heavenly army praising the Divine and saying,

familiar.text: And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host praising God, and saying,

modern.text: And suddenly there appeared with the angel a great multitude of the heavenly host, praising God and saying:

original.text: καὶ ἐξαίφνης ἐγένετο σὺν τῷ ἀγγέλῳ πλῆθος στρατιᾶς ⸀οὐρανίου αἰνούντων τὸν θεὸν καὶ λεγόντων·

verses.restored: Glory to the Divine in the highest, and on earth peace among people of favor.

familiar.text: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men.

modern.text: “Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace to men on whom His favor rests!”

original.text: Δόξα ἐν ὑψίστοις θεῷ καὶ ἐπὶ γῆς εἰρήνη ἐν ἀνθρώποις ⸀εὐδοκίας.

verses.restored: When the messengers went away from them into heaven, the shepherds were saying to one another, Let us go through to Bethlehem and see this word/event that has happened, which the Lord made known to us.

familiar.text: And it came to pass, as the angels were gone away from them into heaven, the shepherds said one to another, Let us now go even unto Bethlehem, and see this thing which is come to pass, which the Lord hath made known unto us.

modern.text: When the angels had left them and gone into heaven, the shepherds said to one another, “Let us go to Bethlehem and see this thing that has happened, which the Lord has made known to us.”

original.text: Καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς ἀπῆλθον ἀπʼ αὐτῶν εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν οἱ ἄγγελοι, ⸀οἱ ποιμένες ⸀ἐλάλουν πρὸς ἀλλήλους· Διέλθωμεν δὴ ἕως Βηθλέεμ καὶ ἴδωμεν τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο τὸ γεγονὸς ὃ ὁ κύριος ἐγνώρισεν ἡμῖν.

verses.restored: They went with haste and found Mary and Joseph, and the baby lying in the manger.

familiar.text: And they came with haste, and found Mary, and Joseph, and the babe lying in a manger.

modern.text: So they hurried off and found Mary and Joseph and the Baby, who was lying in the manger.

original.text: καὶ ἦλθαν σπεύσαντες καὶ ἀνεῦραν τήν τε Μαριὰμ καὶ τὸν Ἰωσὴφ καὶ τὸ βρέφος κείμενον ἐν τῇ φάτνῃ·

verses.restored: Seeing, they made known the word spoken to them concerning this child.

familiar.text: And when they had seen it, they made known abroad the saying which was told them concerning this child.

modern.text: After they had seen the Child, they spread the message they had received about Him.

original.text: ἰδόντες δὲ ⸀ἐγνώρισαν περὶ τοῦ ῥήματος τοῦ λαληθέντος αὐτοῖς περὶ τοῦ παιδίου τούτου.

verses.restored: All who heard marveled concerning the things spoken by the shepherds to them.

familiar.text: And all they that heard it wondered at those things which were told them by the shepherds.

modern.text: And all who heard it were amazed at what the shepherds said to them.

original.text: καὶ πάντες οἱ ἀκούσαντες ἐθαύμασαν περὶ τῶν λαληθέντων ὑπὸ τῶν ποιμένων πρὸς αὐτούς,

verses.restored: But Mary kept all these words/events, pondering them in her heart.

familiar.text: But Mary kept all these things, and pondered them in her heart.

modern.text: But Mary treasured up all these things and pondered them in her heart.

original.text: ἡ δὲ ⸀Μαρία πάντα συνετήρει τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα συμβάλλουσα ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτῆς.

verses.restored: The shepherds returned, glorifying and praising the Divine for all they heard and saw, just as it had been spoken to them.

familiar.text: And the shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, as it was told unto them.

modern.text: The shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all they had heard and seen, which was just as the angel had told them. Jesus Presented at the Temple

original.text: καὶ ὑπέστρεψαν οἱ ποιμένες δοξάζοντες καὶ αἰνοῦντες τὸν θεὸν ἐπὶ πᾶσιν οἷς ἤκουσαν καὶ εἶδον καθὼς ἐλαλήθη πρὸς αὐτούς.

verses.restored: When eight days were fulfilled to circumcise him, his name was called Jesus, the name called by the messenger before he was conceived in the womb.

familiar.text: And when eight days were accomplished for the circumcising of the child, his name was called JESUS, which was so named of the angel before he was conceived in the womb.

modern.text: When the eight days until His circumcision had passed, He was named Jesus, the name the angel had given Him before He had been conceived.

original.text: Καὶ ὅτε ἐπλήσθησαν ἡμέραι ὀκτὼ τοῦ περιτεμεῖν αὐτόν, καὶ ἐκλήθη τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ἰησοῦς, τὸ κληθὲν ὑπὸ τοῦ ἀγγέλου πρὸ τοῦ συλλημφθῆναι αὐτὸν ἐν τῇ κοιλίᾳ.

verses.restored: When the days of their purification according to the Law of Moses were fulfilled, they brought him up to Jerusalem to present him to the Lord,

familiar.text: And when the days of her purification according to the law of Moses were accomplished, they brought him to Jerusalem, to present him to the Lord;

modern.text: And when the time of purification according to the Law of Moses was complete, His parents brought Him to Jerusalem to present Him to the Lord

original.text: Καὶ ὅτε ἐπλήσθησαν αἱ ἡμέραι τοῦ καθαρισμοῦ αὐτῶν κατὰ τὸν νόμον Μωϋσέως, ἀνήγαγον αὐτὸν εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα παραστῆσαι τῷ κυρίῳ,

verses.restored: as it has been written in the Law of the Lord: Every male opening the womb shall be called holy to the Lord,

familiar.text: (As it is written in the law of the LORD, Every male that openeth the womb shall be called holy to the Lord;)

modern.text: (as it is written in the Law of the Lord: “Every firstborn male shall be consecrated to the Lord” ),

original.text: καθὼς γέγραπται ἐν νόμῳ κυρίου ὅτι Πᾶν ἄρσεν διανοῖγον μήτραν ἅγιον τῷ κυρίῳ κληθήσεται,

verses.restored: and to give a sacrifice according to what is said in the Law of the Lord: a pair of turtledoves or two young pigeons.

familiar.text: And to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.

modern.text: and to offer the sacrifice specified in the Law of the Lord: “A pair of turtledoves or two young pigeons.” The Prophecy of Simeon

original.text: καὶ τοῦ δοῦναι θυσίαν κατὰ τὸ εἰρημένον ἐν ⸀τῷ νόμῳ κυρίου, ζεῦγος τρυγόνων ἢ δύο νοσσοὺς περιστερῶν.

verses.restored: Look, there was a man in Jerusalem whose name was Simeon; this man was righteous and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel, and holy Spirit was upon him.

familiar.text: And, behold, there was a man in Jerusalem, whose name was Simeon; and the same man was just and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel: and the Holy Ghost was upon him.

modern.text: Now there was a man in Jerusalem named Simeon, who was righteous and devout. He was waiting for the consolation of Israel, and the Holy Spirit was upon him.

original.text: Καὶ ἰδοὺ ⸂ἄνθρωπος ἦν⸃ ἐν Ἰερουσαλὴμ ᾧ ὄνομα Συμεών, καὶ ὁ ἄνθρωπος οὗτος δίκαιος καὶ εὐλαβής, προσδεχόμενος παράκλησιν τοῦ Ἰσραήλ, καὶ πνεῦμα ἦν ἅγιον ἐπʼ αὐτόν·

verses.restored: It had been revealed to him by the holy Spirit that he would not see death before he saw the Lord's Messiah.

familiar.text: And it was revealed unto him by the Holy Ghost, that he should not see death, before he had seen the Lord’s Christ.

modern.text: The Holy Spirit had revealed to him that he would not see death before he had seen the Lord’s Christ.

original.text: καὶ ἦν αὐτῷ κεχρηματισμένον ὑπὸ τοῦ πνεύματος τοῦ ἁγίου μὴ ἰδεῖν θάνατον πρὶν ⸂ἢ ἂν⸃ ἴδῃ τὸν χριστὸν κυρίου.

verses.restored: He came in the Spirit into the temple; and when the parents brought in the child Jesus to do for him according to the custom of the Law,

familiar.text: And he came by the Spirit into the temple: and when the parents brought in the child Jesus, to do for him after the custom of the law,

modern.text: Led by the Spirit, he went into the temple courts. And when the parents brought in the child Jesus to do for Him what was customary under the Law,

original.text: καὶ ἦλθεν ἐν τῷ πνεύματι εἰς τὸ ἱερόν· καὶ ἐν τῷ εἰσαγαγεῖν τοὺς γονεῖς τὸ παιδίον Ἰησοῦν τοῦ ποιῆσαι αὐτοὺς κατὰ τὸ εἰθισμένον τοῦ νόμου περὶ αὐτοῦ

verses.restored: he received him into his arms, blessed the Divine, and said,

familiar.text: Then took he him up in his arms, and blessed God, and said,

modern.text: Simeon took Him in his arms and blessed God, saying:

original.text: καὶ αὐτὸς ἐδέξατο αὐτὸ εἰς τὰς ⸀ἀγκάλας καὶ εὐλόγησεν τὸν θεὸν καὶ εἶπεν·

verses.restored: Now you release your servant, Master, according to your word, in peace,

familiar.text: Lord, now lettest thou thy servant depart in peace, according to thy word:

modern.text: “Sovereign Lord, as You have promised, You now dismiss Your servant in peace.

original.text: Νῦν ἀπολύεις τὸν δοῦλόν σου, δέσποτα, κατὰ τὸ ῥῆμά σου ἐν εἰρήνῃ·

verses.restored: because my eyes have seen your salvation,

familiar.text: For mine eyes have seen thy salvation,

modern.text: For my eyes have seen Your salvation,

original.text: ὅτι εἶδον οἱ ὀφθαλμοί μου τὸ σωτήριόν σου

verses.restored: which you prepared before the face of all peoples,

familiar.text: Which thou hast prepared before the face of all people;

modern.text: which You have prepared in the sight of all people,

original.text: ὃ ἡτοίμασας κατὰ πρόσωπον πάντων τῶν λαῶν,

verses.restored: a light for revelation to the nations and glory of your people Israel.

familiar.text: A light to lighten the Gentiles, and the glory of thy people Israel.

modern.text: a light for revelation to the Gentiles, and for glory to Your people Israel.”

original.text: φῶς εἰς ἀποκάλυψιν ἐθνῶν καὶ δόξαν λαοῦ σου Ἰσραήλ.

verses.restored: His father and mother were marveling at the things spoken concerning him.

familiar.text: And Joseph and his mother marvelled at those things which were spoken of him.

modern.text: The Child’s father and mother were amazed at what was spoken about Him.

original.text: καὶ ἦν ⸂ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ⸃ καὶ ἡ ⸀μήτηρ θαυμάζοντες ἐπὶ τοῖς λαλουμένοις περὶ αὐτοῦ.

verses.restored: Simeon blessed them and said to Mary his mother, Look, this one is appointed for falling and rising of many in Israel, and for a sign spoken against,

familiar.text: And Simeon blessed them, and said unto Mary his mother, Behold, this child is set for the fall and rising again of many in Israel; and for a sign which shall be spoken against;

modern.text: Then Simeon blessed them and said to His mother Mary: “Behold, this Child is appointed to cause the rise and fall of many in Israel, and to be a sign that will be spoken against,

original.text: καὶ εὐλόγησεν αὐτοὺς Συμεὼν καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς Μαριὰμ τὴν μητέρα αὐτοῦ· Ἰδοὺ οὗτος κεῖται εἰς πτῶσιν καὶ ἀνάστασιν πολλῶν ἐν τῷ Ἰσραὴλ καὶ εἰς σημεῖον ἀντιλεγόμενον,

verses.restored: and a sword will pass through your own soul also, so that reasonings from many hearts may be revealed.

familiar.text: (Yea, a sword shall pierce through thy own soul also,) that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.

modern.text: so that the thoughts of many hearts will be revealed— and a sword will pierce your soul as well.” The Prophecy of Anna

original.text: καὶ σοῦ ⸀δὲ αὐτῆς τὴν ψυχὴν διελεύσεται ῥομφαία, ὅπως ἂν ἀποκαλυφθῶσιν ἐκ πολλῶν καρδιῶν διαλογισμοί.

verses.restored: There was Anna, a prophetess, daughter of Phanuel, from the tribe of Asher; she was advanced in many days, having lived with a husband seven years from her virginity,

familiar.text: And there was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Aser: she was of a great age, and had lived with an husband seven years from her virginity;

modern.text: There was also a prophetess named Anna, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher, who was well along in years. She had been married for seven years,

original.text: Καὶ ἦν Ἅννα προφῆτις, θυγάτηρ Φανουήλ, ἐκ φυλῆς Ἀσήρ (αὕτη προβεβηκυῖα ἐν ἡμέραις πολλαῖς, ζήσασα ⸂μετὰ ἀνδρὸς ἔτη⸃ ἑπτὰ ἀπὸ τῆς παρθενίας αὐτῆς,

verses.restored: and she was a widow until eighty-four years, who did not depart from the temple, serving with fastings and prayers night and day.

familiar.text: And she was a widow of about fourscore and four years, which departed not from the temple, but served God with fastings and prayers night and day.

modern.text: and then was a widow to the age of eighty-four. She never left the temple, but worshiped night and day, fasting and praying.

original.text: καὶ αὐτὴ χήρα ⸀ἕως ἐτῶν ὀγδοήκοντα τεσσάρων,) ἣ οὐκ ⸀ἀφίστατο τοῦ ἱεροῦ νηστείαις καὶ δεήσεσιν λατρεύουσα νύκτα καὶ ἡμέραν.

verses.restored: At that very hour she stood near, gave thanks to the Divine, and spoke about him to all those waiting for redemption of Jerusalem.

familiar.text: And she coming in that instant gave thanks likewise unto the Lord, and spake of him to all them that looked for redemption in Jerusalem.

modern.text: Coming forward at that moment, she gave thanks to God and spoke about the Child to all who were waiting for the redemption of Jerusalem. The Return to Nazareth (Matthew 2:19–23)

original.text: ⸀καὶ αὐτῇ τῇ ὥρᾳ ἐπιστᾶσα ἀνθωμολογεῖτο τῷ ⸀θεῷ καὶ ἐλάλει περὶ αὐτοῦ πᾶσιν τοῖς προσδεχομένοις ⸀λύτρωσιν Ἰερουσαλήμ.

verses.restored: When they completed all things according to the Law of the Lord, they returned to Galilee, to their own city Nazareth.

familiar.text: And when they had performed all things according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city Nazareth.

modern.text: When Jesus’ parents had done everything required by the Law of the Lord, they returned to Galilee, to their own town of Nazareth.

original.text: Καὶ ὡς ἐτέλεσαν ⸀πάντα τὰ κατὰ τὸν νόμον κυρίου, ⸀ἐπέστρεψαν εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν ⸀εἰς πόλιν ἑαυτῶν Ναζαρέθ.

verses.restored: The child grew and became strong, being filled with wisdom; and favor of the Divine was upon him.

familiar.text: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, filled with wisdom: and the grace of God was upon him.

modern.text: And the Child grew and became strong. He was filled with wisdom, and the grace of God was upon Him. The Boy Jesus at the Temple

original.text: Τὸ δὲ παιδίον ηὔξανεν καὶ ἐκραταιοῦτο ⸂πληρούμενον σοφίᾳ⸃, καὶ χάρις θεοῦ ἦν ἐπʼ αὐτό.

verses.restored: His parents went each year to Jerusalem for the feast of Passover.

familiar.text: Now his parents went to Jerusalem every year at the feast of the passover.

modern.text: Every year His parents went to Jerusalem for the Feast of the Passover.

original.text: Καὶ ἐπορεύοντο οἱ γονεῖς αὐτοῦ κατʼ ἔτος εἰς Ἰερουσαλὴμ τῇ ἑορτῇ τοῦ πάσχα.

verses.restored: When he became twelve years old, they went up according to the custom of the feast.

familiar.text: And when he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem after the custom of the feast.

modern.text: And when He was twelve years old, they went up according to the custom of the Feast.

original.text: καὶ ὅτε ἐγένετο ἐτῶν δώδεκα, ⸀ἀναβαινόντων ⸀αὐτῶν κατὰ τὸ ἔθος τῆς ἑορτῆς

verses.restored: After completing the days, as they were returning, the boy Jesus remained behind in Jerusalem, and his parents did not know it.

familiar.text: And when they had fulfilled the days, as they returned, the child Jesus tarried behind in Jerusalem; and Joseph and his mother knew not of it.

modern.text: When those days were over and they were returning home, the boy Jesus remained behind in Jerusalem, but His parents were unaware He had stayed.

original.text: καὶ τελειωσάντων τὰς ἡμέρας, ἐν τῷ ὑποστρέφειν αὐτοὺς ὑπέμεινεν Ἰησοῦς ὁ παῖς ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ, καὶ οὐκ ⸂ἔγνωσαν οἱ γονεῖς⸃ αὐτοῦ.

verses.restored: Supposing him to be in the travel group, they went a day's journey and were seeking him among relatives and acquaintances.

familiar.text: But they, supposing him to have been in the company, went a day’s journey; and they sought him among their kinsfolk and acquaintance.

modern.text: Assuming He was in their company, they traveled on for a day before they began to look for Him among their relatives and friends.

original.text: νομίσαντες δὲ αὐτὸν ⸂εἶναι ἐν τῇ συνοδίᾳ⸃ ἦλθον ἡμέρας ὁδὸν καὶ ἀνεζήτουν αὐτὸν ἐν τοῖς συγγενεῦσιν ⸀καὶ τοῖς γνωστοῖς,

verses.restored: Not finding him, they returned to Jerusalem seeking him.

familiar.text: And when they found him not, they turned back again to Jerusalem, seeking him.

modern.text: When they could not find Him, they returned to Jerusalem to search for Him.

original.text: καὶ μὴ ⸀εὑρόντες ὑπέστρεψαν εἰς Ἰερουσαλὴμ ⸀ἀναζητοῦντες αὐτόν.

verses.restored: After three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the teachers, hearing them and questioning them.

familiar.text: And it came to pass, that after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the doctors, both hearing them, and asking them questions.

modern.text: Finally, after three days they found Him in the temple courts, sitting among the teachers, listening to them and asking them questions.

original.text: καὶ ἐγένετο μετὰ ἡμέρας τρεῖς εὗρον αὐτὸν ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ καθεζόμενον ἐν μέσῳ τῶν διδασκάλων καὶ ἀκούοντα αὐτῶν καὶ ἐπερωτῶντα αὐτούς·

verses.restored: All those hearing him were astonished at his understanding and answers.

familiar.text: And all that heard him were astonished at his understanding and answers.

modern.text: And all who heard Him were astounded at His understanding and His answers.

original.text: ἐξίσταντο δὲ πάντες οἱ ἀκούοντες αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τῇ συνέσει καὶ ταῖς ἀποκρίσεσιν αὐτοῦ.

verses.restored: Seeing him, they were struck with wonder, and his mother said to him, Child, why did you do this to us? Look, your father and I were distressed, seeking you.

familiar.text: And when they saw him, they were amazed: and his mother said unto him, Son, why hast thou thus dealt with us? behold, thy father and I have sought thee sorrowing.

modern.text: When His parents saw Him, they were astonished. “Child, why have You done this to us?” His mother asked. “Your father and I have been anxiously searching for You.”

original.text: καὶ ἰδόντες αὐτὸν ἐξεπλάγησαν, καὶ ⸂εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτὸν ἡ μήτηρ αὐτοῦ⸃· Τέκνον, τί ἐποίησας ἡμῖν οὕτως; ἰδοὺ ὁ πατήρ σου καὶ ἐγὼ ὀδυνώμενοι ⸀ἐζητοῦμέν σε.

verses.restored: He said to them, Why were you seeking me? Did you not know that it is necessary for me to be in the things/house of my Father?

familiar.text: And he said unto them, How is it that ye sought me? wist ye not that I must be about my Father’s business?

modern.text: “Why were you looking for Me?” He asked. “Did you not know that I had to be in My Father’s house ?”

original.text: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς· Τί ὅτι ἐζητεῖτέ με; οὐκ ᾔδειτε ὅτι ἐν τοῖς τοῦ πατρός μου δεῖ εἶναί με;

verses.restored: They did not understand the word that he spoke to them.

familiar.text: And they understood not the saying which he spake unto them.

modern.text: But they did not understand the statement He was making to them.

original.text: καὶ αὐτοὶ οὐ συνῆκαν τὸ ῥῆμα ὃ ἐλάλησεν αὐτοῖς.

verses.restored: He went down with them and came to Nazareth, and was subject to them. His mother kept all these words/events in her heart.

familiar.text: And he went down with them, and came to Nazareth, and was subject unto them: but his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.

modern.text: Then He went down to Nazareth with them and was obedient to them. But His mother treasured up all these things in her heart.

original.text: καὶ κατέβη μετʼ αὐτῶν καὶ ἦλθεν εἰς Ναζαρέθ, καὶ ἦν ὑποτασσόμενος αὐτοῖς. καὶ ἡ μήτηρ αὐτοῦ διετήρει πάντα τὰ ῥήματα ⸀ταῦτα ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτῆς.

verses.restored: Jesus advanced in wisdom and stature, and in favor with the Divine and humans.

familiar.text: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favour with God and man.

modern.text: And Jesus grew in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and man.

original.text: Καὶ Ἰησοῦς προέκοπτεν ⸂σοφίᾳ καὶ ἡλικίᾳ⸃ καὶ χάριτι παρὰ θεῷ καὶ ἀνθρώποις.
